programs.title: Reading DNA Above the Pacific: Genomics and Trusted Data at Illumina HQ
outcomes: Explain what DNA sequencing is and why San Diego's Torrey Pines Mesa is a genomics hub
Model how a blockchain-style ledger records data without changing it
Identify who should decide how sensitive data is used

sessions.activity: Discuss the DAO charter mission: AI and data as a public good. Class writes its own mini-charter listing what decisions only people should vote on.
Decode a paper 'DNA sequence' (colored beads or cards) and compare team results; explore why checking evidence matters before drawing conclusions.
Small groups draft proposals for how a class genome databank could be used; peers debate and vote, experiencing human-governed decisions.
Teams create posters tracking their mini-charter outcomes and present how their decisions changed the databank's use.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised class results from the bead-sequencing exercise (patterns only, no personal information) contributed to a shared example dataset showing group variation.
programs.consent: Signed guardian/parent consent forms for all activities; no real DNA or personal data collected; opt-out available; teacher deletes identifiable records after the unit.

programs.title: Genomics, Data Rights, and the Future of Biotech Work
outcomes: Describe how sequencing and data systems are changing biotech and health jobs
Analyze workplace data-collection risks and worker data rights
Practice collective voice in data-governance decisions

sessions.activity: Review the mission of governing AI and data as a public good; map which decisions must stay with people, mirroring union democracy.
Evidence Monitor walkthrough: how agents summarize evidence; members critique a sample synthesis on automation in genomics labs.
Members draft and debate a model data-rights proposal (e.g., consent before workplace genomic data use), then hold a mock final vote reserved for people.
Task Router demo: how work gets routed to working groups; members identify skills needed for genomics-adjacent job transitions.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized survey responses on training needs and job-change concerns, aggregated into shared workforce-transition models.
programs.consent: Voluntary participation, informed consent before any survey, individual responses anonymized and aggregated, right to withdraw data at any time.

programs.title: Evidence to Action: Monitoring Genomics and AI Governance
outcomes: Use agent-summarized evidence responsibly in advocacy
Draft fundable, measurable proposals for human decision-makers
Track outcomes transparently against a charter

sessions.activity: Practice with Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent outputs: evaluate source quality and bias in genomics-AI coverage.
Workshop on defining measurable outcomes for a data-governance mission, using the DAO charter structure as a template.
Teams draft a grant-style proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter workflow, then simulate human-only review and enactment.
Build a progress dashboard for one campaign; peer review on whether metrics match stated outcomes.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized campaign metrics and proposal-outcome summaries shared across participating NGOs to improve shared evidence models.
programs.consent: Organizational data-sharing agreements; all contributed data anonymized and aggregated; communities referenced are consulted before inclusion.

programs.title: Public-Good Genomics: A Community Learning Cycle
outcomes: Connect local genomics heritage (Torrey Pines Mesa) to shared-benefit principles
Co-design a community proposal through human vote

sessions.activity: Storytelling session on sequencing's home base on the Torrey Pines coastal bluffs and the mission of widely shared benefits; group reflects on 'public good.'
Facilitated walkthrough of an evidence summary on genomic data use; learners flag questions and concerns for stewards.
Learners co-draft a small community education proposal; agents prepare drafts, people debate and cast the deciding vote.
Review the Progress Tracker together; learners suggest new measurable outcomes for the next cycle.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized feedback and learning-outcome summaries that help improve the shared education program model.
programs.consent: Plain-language consent forms, opt-in only, no personal or genetic data collected, anonymization before any sharing, withdrawal honored on request.
